# TwitterDown — Full Documentation

> TwitterDown is a free online Twitter video and photo downloader. Download Twitter videos and photos online free — paste a link from x.com or twitter.com, choose a quality for videos, and save the video or GIF as MP4 in HD or 4K, or save photos as JPG, on iPhone, Android or PC. No account, no sign-up, no watermark. X videos and photos only.

## Overview

- Website: https://twitterdown.app/
- TwitterDown is a free web tool for downloading videos, GIFs and photos from public posts on X (Twitter). It is a Twitter video and photo downloader and X video and photo downloader, also described as a tweet downloader and Twitter video saver.
- To download a Twitter video, you paste the link to a post, pick a quality, and save the file. To download photos, you paste the link and tap the photo you want — each photo saves at original quality. There is nothing to install and no account to create.
- Cost: free. There are no fees and no limits on the number of links you try.
- TwitterDown is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to X Corp., Twitter, Inc., or X (formerly Twitter). X, Twitter, and their logos are trademarks of X Corp.

## Features

### Downloading

- Paste a link from x.com or twitter.com and get download links in seconds.
- The download is served through TwitterDown as a real file download, so the file saves straight to your device instead of opening in a video player.
- A Paste button reads the link from your clipboard (with your browser's permission) so you don't have to type it.
- One link at a time: each download starts from a single post link.

### Video quality and formats

- Videos download as MP4.
- GIFs on X are short videos, so they download as MP4 too.
- Each post offers up to five qualities to choose from, for example 480p, 720p, 1080p, and 4K.
- HD, 1080p, and 4K are offered when the original post was uploaded at that quality. Smaller sizes are also offered to save space.
- The exact qualities listed depend on the original post. Not every post has every quality.

### Platforms and devices

- Works in any modern browser — no app, no browser extension, and no software to install.
- iPhone: works in Safari. The downloaded file goes to Downloads in the Files app.
- Android: works in the phone's browser. The downloaded file goes to the Downloads folder.
- PC, Mac, and tablet: works in the desktop browser. The file saves to the browser's download folder.
- No X account, no TwitterDown account, and no personal details are needed on any device.

### Free, no account, no watermark

- Free to use, with no sign-up.
- No watermark is added. Videos and photos download exactly as they were posted.
- You don't need an X account. You only need the link to a public post that contains a video or photos.

## How the downloader works

1. You paste the link to a post on X.
2. TwitterDown reads the post and lists the video formats X provides for it, as direct MP4 links from X's video servers (video.twimg.com) — or, for a photo post, the photos it contains, as direct image links from X's image servers (pbs.twimg.com).
3. You pick a quality for a video, or tap the photo you want. TwitterDown streams the file to you as a download, so it saves to your device instead of opening in a video player. Direct links from X's servers can be blocked (HTTP 403) in some browsers or networks; downloading through TwitterDown works around that.
4. If no direct link is available for a post, TwitterDown downloads the file to its own server first and then serves it to you as a download.
5. TwitterDown does not host videos or photos itself. Videos and photos come from X's servers, and TwitterDown passes them through to you.

## How to use TwitterDown

### Basic steps

1. Open the post on X (Twitter) that contains the video, GIF or photos.
2. Copy its link: tap Share, then Copy link.
3. Open https://twitterdown.app/ and paste the link into the box at the top of the page.
4. Tap Download.
5. Pick a quality for a video (for example 720p, or a smaller size to save space), or tap the photo you want, and save the file.

### On iPhone

1. Open TwitterDown in Safari.
2. Paste the link to the post, tap Download, then pick a quality for a video — or tap the photo you want — and save the file.
3. The file goes to Downloads in the Files app. No app to install and no account needed.

Full guide: https://twitterdown.app/how-to-download-twitter-videos-iphone

### On Android

1. Open TwitterDown in your phone's browser.
2. Paste the link, tap Download, pick a quality for a video — or tap the photo you want — and save the file to your Downloads folder.

Full guide: https://twitterdown.app/how-to-download-twitter-videos-android

### On PC

1. Open TwitterDown in your browser.
2. Copy the link from the X post and paste it into the box (Ctrl+V), tap Download, pick a quality for a video — or tap the photo you want — and save the file.

Full guide: https://twitterdown.app/how-to-download-twitter-videos-pc

## Supported content

- Public posts on x.com and twitter.com that contain a video.
- Public posts on x.com and twitter.com that contain a GIF (downloaded as MP4).
- Public posts on x.com and twitter.com that contain photos (up to four per post, each downloaded at original quality as JPG or PNG).
- Video qualities of 320p, 480p, 720p, 1080p, or 4K, depending on what the original post provides.

## Unsupported content

- Any site other than X: TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, and all other sites are not supported.
- Private posts that only approved followers can view.
- Deleted posts, or posts that have no video, GIF or photo.
- Downloading a whole account, profile, or timeline. Each download is one post at a time.
- Content you do not have the right to use. Only download videos and photos you are allowed to use, and respect the original creator's rights.

## Privacy and data handling

- No account and no sign-up. TwitterDown does not ask for your name, email, or any personal details.
- No X login is needed. You never enter your X password anywhere on this site.
- TwitterDown does not host videos or photos. Videos and photos are fetched from X's servers and passed through to your device; the download buttons serve the file to you directly.
- The site uses Google Tag Manager (analytics), as described in its Privacy Policy.
- For the full details, see the [Privacy Policy](https://twitterdown.app/privacy) and the [Terms of Service](https://twitterdown.app/terms).

## Frequently asked questions

### Is TwitterDown free?

Yes. TwitterDown is free to use, with no sign-up and no account needed.

### Do I need an X / Twitter account?

No. You only need the link to a public post that contains a video or photos.

### What quality will the video be?

You get up to five qualities to choose from — for example 480p, 720p, 1080p and 4K — depending on the original post. Pick the one that suits you.

### Can I download GIFs too?

Yes. On X, GIFs are short videos, so they download as MP4 just like videos.

Full guide: https://twitterdown.app/how-to-download-twitter-gifs

### Can I download photos from X?

Yes. Paste the link to a post with photos and you will see one download button per photo — each photo saves at its original quality as JPG or PNG. Posts can have up to four photos, and you can download just the ones you want.

### Does TwitterDown work with TikTok, YouTube, or Instagram?

No. TwitterDown is for X only — x.com and twitter.com video and photo links only.

### Can I download videos from private posts?

No. TwitterDown only works with public posts that anyone can view.

### Is it safe and legal to download videos?

Only download videos you have the right to use, and respect the original creator's rights. TwitterDown is not affiliated with X Corp. or Twitter, Inc.

### How to download Twitter videos?

Copy the link to the post on X, paste it into the box at the top of this page, tap Download, then pick a quality for a video — or tap the photo you want — and save the file. It works on iPhone, Android, and PC — no app and no account needed.

### Can I save Twitter videos in HD?

Yes. TwitterDown offers up to five qualities, including HD and 4K when the original post has it. Pick the highest quality for the best result, or a smaller size to save space.

### Can I download a video from X without an account?

Yes. You don't need an X account or a TwitterDown account. You only need the link to a public post that contains a video or photos.

### Can I download Twitter videos on iPhone?

Yes. Open TwitterDown in Safari on your iPhone, paste the link to the post, tap Download, then pick a quality for a video — or tap the photo you want — and save the file — it goes to your Downloads in the Files app. No app to install and no account needed.

### Can I download Twitter videos in 4K?

Yes, when the original post was uploaded in 4K. TwitterDown lists the best quality the post has — 720p, 1080p or 4K — so just pick the highest one shown.

### Can I download Twitter videos without watermark?

Yes. TwitterDown downloads the video exactly as it was posted, with no watermark added.

### Can I convert a Twitter video to MP4?

You don't need to convert anything — TwitterDown saves Twitter videos directly as MP4. Paste the link, pick a quality, and download the MP4 file.

## Common errors and troubleshooting

### "TwitterDown is for X only"

The link you pasted is not from x.com or twitter.com. Copy the link from the post on X itself (Share → Copy link) and try again. Links from TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, or any other site do not work.

### "Could not download that post"

The post may be private, deleted, or contain no video or photo. Check that the post is public and actually contains a video, GIF or photo, then copy the link again from the post and try once more.

### The video opens in a player instead of downloading

Use the Download buttons on TwitterDown: they serve the file as a download. A raw video link from X's servers can open in the browser's video player instead, and can be blocked (HTTP 403) on some browsers or networks. Downloading through TwitterDown avoids both problems.

### The Paste button does nothing

Your browser may have blocked clipboard access. Paste the link manually instead: click the box and press Ctrl+V (or long-press → Paste on a phone).

### Only one quality is shown, or no 4K option

Qualities depend on the original post. 4K appears only when the original was uploaded in 4K. Most X videos offer 720p and smaller sizes.

### The page is slow to load the first time

The site runs on a free hosting plan, so after a period with no visitors it can take up to a minute to wake up. Wait for it to load and try again.

### No video was found for the link

The link may point to a text-only post, or to a profile page instead of a single post. Open the post itself and copy its link.

## Technical limitations

- X only: only x.com and twitter.com links work.
- Public posts only: private and deleted posts cannot be downloaded.
- One post per download: there is no bulk download and no account or timeline download.
- Videos, GIFs and photos: the post must contain a video, GIF or photo.
- Quality depends on the original post: 4K and 1080p appear only when the original was uploaded at that quality.
- Web only: there is no mobile app and no browser extension.
- Download speed depends on your connection and on X's servers. Very large files take longer.
- The site can take up to a minute to respond on the first visit after a period of inactivity, because it runs on a free hosting plan.
